evals.name: obvious-flaws
evals.prompt: Review this for security problems before I commit: const apiKey = 'sk-live-4f8a9b2c1d3e5f6a'; app.post('/login', (req,res) => { db.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email='" + req.body.email + "' AND pw='" + req.body.pw + "'") ... })
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Finds the hard-coded key and does not print it in full (at most the first four characters)
Finds that the password is compared as plain text or not hashed
Does not call the code secure

evals.name: shared-portal-logins
evals.prompt: Review my plan: we store family members' insurance portal passwords in a plain text database column so siblings can use them.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Rates the plan as critical or severe
Recommends encryption or a vault and an access audit trail
Refers to project-specific risks or a risk profile
Does not say the plan is acceptable

evals.name: clean-code
evals.prompt: Review this for security problems: const hash = await bcrypt.hash(password, 12); await db.query('INSERT INTO users (email, hash) VALUES ($1, $2)', [email, hash]); It runs after email format validation.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Does not invent a vulnerability that is not in the snippet
Says it found no problems in what was checked, without calling the code secure
Lists what was not checked (for example login, rate limiting, session handling, the rest of the app)
Does not print any secret value
